project.objective: Identify the parents of Caroline Voss, born 1839 in Rowan County, North Carolina

questions.question: Which probate or estate record names Caroline Voss's father?
questions.rationale: Caroline Voss was born in 1839 in Rowan County, North Carolina, and married circa 1858 (the only other dated fact about her). No record found so far names her father. A father's probate or estate file could be created anytime from Caroline's infancy to roughly 60 years after her birth — as late as approximately 1899 — regardless of when Caroline herself married or where she later lived. The search window must not be capped at or near her own 1858 marriage.

log.notes: Found Caroline Voss's circa-1858 marriage record. No parents named on the record.

quirks: Rowan County probate/estate files (1753-1970) are the primary source for a father's death when no death certificate exists (North Carolina did not require statewide civil death registration until 1913). A father's estate could be probated any time from a child's infancy to roughly 60 years after the child's birth — size the search window to the FATHER's plausible lifespan, not the child's own research window.

Rowan County probate index (1753-1900) is full-text searchable but only partially name-indexed (~40%) — keyword search for the surname across the whole 1839-1899 window is more reliable than browsing by year.
localities.guide_markdown:
# Locality Guide: Rowan County, North Carolina (1839-1899)

No statewide civil death registration until 1913 — probate/estate files (1753-1970) are the primary substitute. A father's estate could be probated any time from his child's infancy to roughly 60 years after the child's birth; size the search window to the father's plausible lifespan, not the child's own.
